healthy.description: Nominal checkout behaviour. p95 sits comfortably under the 300 ms contract threshold.

checkout-regression.description: Incident profile for checkout-v2: adds 800 ms and returns 500 on every 5th request. Health probes stay green so Kubernetes does not evict the failing version.

bad-recovery.description: Latency breach without errors. Applied to checkout-v1 to drive the FAILED verdict run: p95 lands near 500 ms, over the contract threshold, while success rate stays at 100%.

missing-telemetry.description: Healthy checkout responses deliberately carry a suppress signal so the demo load generator withholds their ES evidence. The verifier must return INCONCLUSIVE, never PROVED.
